title: fix(spec): a book's Uncategorized group skips docs a sibling book claims
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBAcdSigfjvqX5vZGLrx11PE)_
Fixes #27091

Claim: 6468704954
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `resolveBookTree` 的合成 *Uncategorized* 组只收「没有任何已注册 book 认领」的本包文档；`GET /meta/book/:name/tree` 把它已读到的全部 book 传进去。签名只加了一个可选的第四参数 `books`。控制台文档侧栏用的本地移植版 `book-nav.ts` 同步改成同样的规则，页面传入已编写的 book（不含合成的隐式包 book）。
- **为什么改：** 同一个包拆成两本书（如用户手册 + 按 `permissionSet` 限定的管理员手册）时，两本书的树都把对方的页面列在 *Uncategorized* 下；ADR-0046 §6.4 只汇总「未被放置」的文档，被兄弟书放置的文档不算。HotCRM 实测（hotcrm#2327）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只会从兜底组里移除条目，不会让任何文档出现在新的位置；§6.7 受众并集不变（认领集本来就排除兜底组，测试钉住）。不传 `books` 的调用方结果逐字节不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/system/book.zod.ts`（`resolveBookTree` 孤儿过滤与新的 `claimsPerBook`）、`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` 的 `readableTree`、`ui/apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts`（移植版同一处）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/book.test.ts -t "sibling book"` 跑出 5 条全绿；两本书互不相交的 include 下，两棵树都没有 `uncategorized` 组。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`resolveBookTree(book, docs, bookPackage?, books?)`** (`@objectstack/spec`, additive): an optional fourth argument, every registered book. With it, the synthetic *Uncategorized* group takes only the docs of the book's packages that NO book in `books` claims. Without it, the answer is the same as before, byte for byte. The docblock states the new rule and cites ADR-0046 §6.4.
- **One claim judge.** The pass `resolveDocAudiences` already ran (`resolveBookClaimedDocs` over each book with its own `packageId`) is now the private generator `claimsPerBook`. `resolveDocAudiences` unions audiences over it, and `resolveBookTree`'s orphan pass reads its union (`claimedByBooks`). No second judge was written. There is no recursion: `resolveBookClaimedDocs` calls `resolveBookTree` without `books`.
- **`GET /meta/book/:name/tree`** (`@objectstack/rest`): `DocsAudience.readableTree` passes the books the audience was built over (the route's own book read, `?package=` scope included). The `readableTree` docblock says so.
- **Liveness evidence**: `packages/spec/liveness/doc.json` quotes the REST call site verbatim, so its quote now reads `resolveBookTree(book, docs, book._packageId, books)`. No row changes grade.
- **Console docs pages** (`@object-ui/console`): `ui/apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts` is the console's own port of the resolver, and its `resolveBookTree` takes the same optional fourth argument. Its private `claimedByBooks` mirrors the spec's (the authored groups' entries of each book, never the synthetic group). `DocPage` (the book sidebar) and `BookPage` (the book landing) pass `useBookData().authoredBooks`. They never pass the portal set, because its synthetic implicit per-package books are a reading fallback, not an authored claim.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/rest` patch, `@object-ui/console` patch, one root `.changeset/` file with both declaration lines.

## Why

hotcrm#2327 measured it on HotCRM 18.2.0. The app ships `crm_manual` and `crm_admin_manual` (gated `{ permissionSet: 'system_admin' }`) over one package. Every doc is claimed by exactly one book, yet an administrator's `GET /api/v1/meta/book/crm_manual/tree` ends with an `uncategorized` group holding the admin pages, and the Admin Manual lists the user pages the same way. "Claimed" was judged against the book's own groups only. #20980 scoped the catch-all to the book's packages but did not cover a sibling book in the same package.

## Callers of `resolveBookTree`

| Caller | Passes `books`? | What it sees |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` `readableTree` (the `/meta/book/:name/tree` answer, both transports) | yes | fixed |
| `packages/spec` `resolveBookClaimedDocs` | no, by design | unaffected: it drops the *Uncategorized* group anyway |
| `ui/packages/app-shell/.../doc-draft.ts` `resolvePlacements` (Studio doc preview) | no | unaffected: it keeps only the authored groups (cut by position), so the catch-all never reaches its answer |
| `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.test.ts` | no | a test of single-book behaviour, unchanged |

The console's docs pages (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocPage.tsx`, `BookPage.tsx`) do not call the spec function. They call `book-nav.ts`'s own local port of it. On `bce03897` that port still judged "claimed" per book: with the HotCRM fixture below it answered `crm_manual` → `{"start":["crm_overview"],"sales":["crm_sales_leads"],"uncategorized":["crm_admin_access","crm_admin_automation"]}`. Its header calls it "a faithful local port", so the second commit (`7f1a2b23`, added to the claim by amendment 6470220479) gives it the same rule, and both pages pass the authored books.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/book.test.ts`, a new describe block (5 tests) for a doc a sibling book claims:
  1. Two books with disjoint includes over one package: neither tree has an `uncategorized` group.
  2. A doc no book claims still rolls up under *Uncategorized*, in both books of its package.
  3. An `audience`-gated sibling's docs never reach the other book's tree, and every entry with `books` was already an entry without it (the catch-all only shrinks).
  4. The §6.7 audience union is pinned unchanged (`resolveDocAudiences` over both books plus a stray doc), and each book's claim set equals its tree's authored entries.
  5. A single-book package is byte-identical (`JSON.stringify`) to the tree without `books`.
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.siblingBooks-27091.test.tsx` (new, 4 tests), on the HotCRM fixture:
  1. Neither book's port tree has an `uncategorized` group, and each equals the spec resolver's answer with the same books (what the tree route serves).
  2. A doc no book claims still rolls up under *Uncategorized*.
  3. Control: without `books` the port's tree is unchanged.
  4. `DocPage` rendered at `/docs/crm_manual/crm_overview` shows the book's own pages, no *Uncategorized* heading, and no link to either admin page.
- `packages/rest/src/rest.test.ts`: a holder of every book opens `org_book` and `gated_book` through the route. Each tree is `{ g: [own], uncategorized: ['loose_note'] }`. The comment on the existing anonymous-tree test now gives the new reason the sibling docs are absent.

## Acceptance notes

- **`?package=` scope.** The tree route reads books in the same package scope as its docs, so under `?package=X` only X's books judge X's catch-all. Two shapes of a book of ANOTHER package can claim an X doc, and neither judges there: a group whose `include` matches the doc because the group carries `package: X`, and a group whose `key` an X doc names in its explicit `group`. Without `?package=`, every book judges.
- **Console reads its books unscoped.** `useBookData` reads every book and doc through `meta.getItems`, so in the console every authored book judges.

## Verification

Base `origin/main` `d745bb5e`; head `e4a5898d`. The spec and REST readings below were taken on `bce03897`. The second and third commits touch only the console files, the changeset and one indent in `rest.test.ts`. The console readings and the derived gates were taken on `e4a5898d`.

<details><summary>Measure first (base d745bb5e, HotCRM's two-book fixture)</summary>

```
crm_manual tree        {"start":["crm_overview"],"sales":["crm_sales_leads"],"uncategorized":["crm_admin_access","crm_admin_automation"]}
crm_admin_manual tree  {"admin":["crm_admin_access","crm_admin_automation"],"uncategorized":["crm_overview","crm_sales_leads"]}
audiences              [["crm_overview",["org"]],["crm_sales_leads",["org"]],["crm_admin_access",[{"permissionSet":"system_admin"}]],["crm_admin_automation",[{"permissionSet":"system_admin"}]]]
```

The same script on this branch:

```
crm_manual tree        {"start":["crm_overview"],"sales":["crm_sales_leads"]}
crm_admin_manual tree  {"admin":["crm_admin_access","crm_admin_automation"]}
audiences              (identical to base)
```
</details>

- Console page: `DocPage` calling `resolveBookTree(book, allDocs)` without `authoredBooks` turns the rendered-sidebar test red (1 of 4). Restored: blob == HEAD `d41eb5b096ad`. The first try of this leg matched no test file (a path filter the vitest project did not resolve), so it measured nothing. It was re-run with a name filter.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
